The '''Patriim shipyards''' were located in the [[Patriim system/Legends|Patriim system]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hockaleg]]. The shipyards were used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to do work on several major naval vessels. Notable examples included finishing and activating the [[dreadnought]] ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]'', doing some early construction on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]<ref name="TEA1">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and turning the [[Eclipse-class dreadnought|''Eclipse''-class]] prototype into the operational battlestation [[Tarkin (superweapon)|''Tarkin'']].<ref name="TEA1" />
